ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Shells Spawn by Java Utility Keytool
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious shell spawn from Java utility keytool process (e.g. adselfservice plus exploitation)

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\keytool\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\bash\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\whoami\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\bitsadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\scrcons\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\hh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\forfiles\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\scriptrunner\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mftrace\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\AppVLP\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\systeminfo\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\query\\\.exe$")))
